lanEmpty: No LAN worlds found on this network.
managedDescription: Install, configure, and inspect independent local servers.
createNotice: Downloads are verified. Creation does not accept the EULA or start the server.
importUnknown: The server software could not be identified.

importUnsupported.installer: This is an installer, not a server. Run it to install the server, then import the folder it creates.
importUnsupported.argsFile: This server starts only from an arguments file (Forge 1.17 and later without a shim JAR, or NeoForge), which the launcher cannot import yet.
importUnsupported.noJar: This folder has no server JAR the launcher can run.
importUnsupported.needsFolder: This JAR cannot start on its own: it needs the libraries and server files of the folder it was installed in. Import that folder instead.

consolePlaceholder: Enter a console command, such as list

notice.serverSaved: Server saved to the game list.
notice.serverRemoved: Server removed. The previous list was backed up.
notice.serverCreated: Server installed. Review and accept the EULA before starting.
notice.serverImported: Server imported. Review and accept the EULA before starting.
notice.commandSent: Command sent. See the console log for its result.

errors.processFailed: The server process failed. Review the console logs before restarting.

server.eulaRequired: Read and explicitly accept the Minecraft EULA before starting this server.
server.notFound: The server no longer exists. Refresh the list.
server.snapshotChanged: The saved server list changed. No bookmark was modified. Review the refreshed list before trying again.
server.busy: Another server or download operation is still running.
server.addressInvalid: Enter a valid hostname or IP address with an optional port.
server.portInUse: Another managed server is already using this port.
server.processUnavailable: The server process is not running, so this action is unavailable.
server.importInstaller: This is an installer, not a server. Run it to install the server, then import the folder it creates.
server.importArgsFile: This server starts only from an arguments file (Forge 1.17 and later without a shim JAR, or NeoForge), which the launcher cannot import yet.
server.importNoJar: This folder has no server JAR the launcher can run.
server.importProperties: The server's server.properties sets {{key}} to a value the launcher cannot manage. Change it there, then import again.
server.importNotJar: This file is not a valid JAR.
server.importOwnData: This is the launcher's own data folder or a folder inside it. Choose the server's own folder.
server.importLinks: The server folder contains links, junctions or special files, so it cannot be imported.
server.importTooLarge: This server is larger than the launcher can import: more than 100,000 files, 32 GiB or 64 folder levels, or a JAR over 2 GiB.
server.importChanged: Some of the server's files changed or could not be read while they were copied. If it is running, stop it, then import again.
server.importedJarMissing: The imported server's JAR is missing from its folder. Import the server again.
server.importedRecordInvalid: This imported server's record is damaged. Import the server again.
server.importNeedsFolder: This JAR cannot start on its own: it needs the libraries and server files of the folder it was installed in. Import that folder instead.
server.importPropertiesText: The server's server.properties is not UTF-8 text, is over 1 MiB or cannot be read. Save it as UTF-8, then import again.
server.importJarName: The launcher cannot run a JAR with this name: it must end in .jar, must not start with @ or -, and must not be a name Windows reserves. Rename it, then import again.
